findings.title: Concatenated SQL includes the caller-supplied name
findings.explanation: If name is untrusted, quote characters can change the SQL query. This fixture demonstrates the review UI; no live model was called.
findings.guidance: Use a PreparedStatement with a ? placeholder and setString(1, name). Close statement/result resources with try-with-resources. Test a name containing an apostrophe as literal data.

evidence.snippet: return db.createStatement().executeQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'");

findings.title: Addition is isolated in a deterministic method
findings.explanation: This method reads only its arguments and returns a value, which permits direct unit tests. Fixture-provider output only.
findings.guidance: Preserve the absence of external I/O; cover zero, negative values and the intended integer-overflow behavior.

evidence.snippet: public int add(int a, int b) { return a + b; }

limitations: AI findings and severity are proposals for human review, not verified defects, exploits, fixes or measured performance gains.
Evidence validation proves exact path/line/snippet membership only; it does not establish that an AI conclusion is correct.
Scope is the immutable catalog, not the entire remote repository. Intake-excluded, unsupported and oversized files are not reviewed.
Each request reviews up to 8 batches of 20 files / 40,000 source characters. Continue remaining batches explicitly; previous reports are retained.
Related files may be split across batches. No repository-wide call graph, RAG retrieval, vulnerability database lookup or execution is performed.
A completed review or empty findings list is not proof of correctness, security, performance or absence of defects.
